definitions.explanation: The period of life roughly from the late thirties to the mid-fifties, considered a person's most productive and vigorous adult years. In Japanese usage this often emphasizes capability and maturity rather than decline.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{壮年|そうねん}{期|き}を{迎|むか}えた。
{壮年|そうねん}{期|き}は{体力|たいりょく}と{経験|けいけん}のバランスが{良|よ}い{時期|じき}だ。
examples.english: Middle age is a period when physical strength and experience are well balanced.

examples.japanese: {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}の{男性|だんせい}は{仕事|しごと}でも{家庭|かてい}でも{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}な{役割|やくわり}を{担|にな}うことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Men in their prime often play a central role both at work and in the family.

notes:
Refers to the stage of life between youth ({青年期|せいねんき}) and old age ({老年期|ろうねんき}), typically spanning the late thirties through the fifties. The term carries a positive nuance of being at the peak of one's powers, unlike English "middle age" which can imply decline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}を{迎|むか}える: to enter middle age
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}の{男性|だんせい}: middle-aged man
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}の{女性|じょせい}: middle-aged woman
- {壮年|そうねん}{期|き}に{達|たっ}する: to reach one's prime

LIFE STAGE SEQUENCE:
- {幼年期|ようねんき}: early childhood
- {少年期|しょうねんき}: boyhood/girlhood
- {青年期|せいねんき}: youth
- {壮年期|そうねんき}: prime of life / middle age
- {中年期|ちゅうねんき}: middle age (more neutral)
- {老年期|ろうねんき}: old age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中年|ちゅうねん}: middle age — more neutral and sometimes negative; {壮年期|そうねんき} emphasizes vigor
- {働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り: prime working years — focuses specifically on career productivity
